description: Harden, scan, and secure container images and runtimes against privilege escalation and supply-chain exploits. Use when configuring rootless containers, dropping Linux capabilities (--cap-drop=ALL), enforcing read-only root filesystems, scanning container images with Trivy, implementing Distroless base images, or securing the Docker daemon socket.
